name: The Guardian
label: The Guardian
description: The Guardian official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: search, item_get, tags, sections, editions. Docs: https://open-platform.theguardian.com/documentation/. Guardian Open Platform terms. Query api-key. Attribution required. Do not republish full text beyond the allowance. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One The Guardian request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"search"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: search | item_get | tags | sections | editions. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'search'.

schema.label: from-date
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `from-date` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: item_id
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `item_id` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: order-by
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `order-by` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `q` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: section
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `section` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: show-fields
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `show-fields` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: show-tags
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `show-tags` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: to-date
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `to-date` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: search | item_get | tags | editions | sections. Example: 'search'.

configurationParameters.label: Api-Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
